\begin{minipage}{\linewidth}\footnotesize\emph{Notes:} Linear probability models of survival eight years after grant; granted patents of firms and universities filed 2000--2005, grant lag up to ten years; coefficients in percentage points. The coefficient on domestic owner $\times$ EM office is $\delta$ in equation~\eqref{eq:did}: the extra domestic--foreign gap in the emerging-market offices (China, Korea, Russia, Taiwan, Czech Republic) relative to the advanced-economy offices (United States, Japan, Germany, United Kingdom, France). Column 1: office $\times$ filing-year effects only. Columns 2--6: office-specific effects of filing year, technology field (35), citation bin (forward citations to the family: 0, 1, 2, 3--4, 5--9, 10--19, 20 or more) and grant lag in whole years, a common domestic $\times$ grant-lag slope, and in column 2 office $\times$ owner-group effects; columns 3--6 are estimated separately for each owner group. The domestic-owner coefficient is the advanced-economy gap at the mean grant lag. Firm size: inventions filed worldwide in 2000--2005 by the owner's corporate group. Standard errors clustered by owner in parentheses; inference across offices in \SuppTab{S3}{tab:rich}. $^{*}$~$p<0.1$, $^{**}$~$p<0.05$, $^{***}$~$p<0.01$.
